findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new logger, so logs written through it are never recorded
findings.body: `FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`, a separate instance. `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now logs with `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. With a `TestLogger`, that call goes to the throwaway instance, so the original logger's `InfoLogs.Calls`, `Message` and `Ctx` stay empty. Tests that check what the middleware logged will either fail or quietly check nothing. Return the receiver instead: `func (f *TestLogger) FromContext(_ context.Context) Logger { return f }`.
